message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(These are the dates that fell on a Monday, Tuesday, or Friday, creating a three‑day weekend with the adjacent Saturday or Sunday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 1–3 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 20–21 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–8 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | May 22–23 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 4–5 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 9–10 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Monday) | Nov 11–12 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 25–27 |

> **Note:**  
> • These dates reflect the federal holidays that apply nationwide.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.) that may create extra long weekends.  
> • If you need province‑specific data, let me know which province(s) you’re interested in.

---

### Quick‑JSON format (for easy integration)

```json
[
  {"holiday":"New Year’s Day","date":"2023-01-01","longWeekend":["2023-01-01","2023-01-02","2023-01-03"]},
  {"holiday":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20","longWeekend":["2023-02-20","2023-02-21"]},
  {"holiday":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07","longWeekend":["2023-04-07","2023-04-08"]},
  {"holiday":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22","longWeekend":["2023-05-22","2023-05-23"]},
  {"holiday":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-01","longWeekend":["2023-07-01","2023-07-02","2023-07-03"]},
  {"holiday":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04","longWeekend":["2023-09-04","2023-09-05"]},
  {"holiday":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09","longWeekend":["2023-10-09","2023-10-10"]},
  {"holiday":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11","longWeekend":["2023-11-11","2023-11-12"]},
  {"holiday":"Christmas Day","date":"2023-12-25","longWeekend":["2023-12-25","2023-12-26","2023-12-27"]}
]
```

Feel free to copy/paste the JSON into your holiday‑planning app. If you need more granular details (e.g., province‑specific holidays or exact weekend spans for each province), just let me know!
